description.value:
You climbed to the top of an organized crime network through vision, ruthlessness, or sheer intimidation — and then spent every day since fighting to stay there. Building an empire in the underworld is one thing; keeping it, and staying alive while you do, is another entirely.

Whatever drives you now — profit, respect, or an old grudge you haven't let go of — you still command a network of contacts who can move a message or a favor across the galaxy for you.

system.equipment: A fine set of clothes, a gaming set of your choice, and a purse containing 250 credits.
